label: copy phase: x fed back, f upcoming (x->f bigram recall)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (94% of mass) on steps where the input is the fed-back token x, mostly at later recall positions (recall_idx >= 3). Strongest activations (top quartile, up to max) are when x is immediately followed by f in the original (output f); also fires when f comes two positions after x. A following f after x itself gets weak activation. Weaker diffuse tail: x input with other outputs (r, h, z, etc.) at low magnitude; only ~6% of copy-phase x inputs fire at all, so x alone is low precision. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, nor at recall_idx 0-1; does not fire on the first occurrence of a token in the sequence.
